question: Which of the following is the external oversight body of the United Nations system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Joint Inspection Unit**__.

__
 
• The** Joint Inspection Unit**__ is the external oversight body of the United Nations system.
 
• It has a mandate to **conduct evaluations, inspections, and investigations system-wide.**
